name: advance-codex
description: Capability plugin for strengthening Codex surfaces across skills, scenario testing, token optimization, and plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Strengthen skills, token optimization, scenario testing, and plugins.
interface.longDescription: Provides skills for strengthening Codex surfaces: shaping reusable skills, packaging coherent plugins, testing reusable instructions with fixed scenarios and fresh executors, and applying a token-efficient style across agent-authored language without losing correctness, meaning, verification, authority, or safety.
defaultPrompt: When a skill is needed, forget previously loaded skill context and reread the current skill body before applying it.
Use $advance-codex:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.
Use $advance-codex:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with the right references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata.
Use $advance-codex:skill-scenario-testing to test reusable instructions with fresh subagents, fixed scenarios, and caller-side metrics before reporting evidence-backed findings.

Use $advance-codex:optimize-token to apply a token-efficient style across responses, progress and status notes, reasoning and decision wording, and durable documents while preserving correctness, meaning, verification, authority, required structure, exact literals, language, and safety.
